subject: NeuroFlux discovery — pilot scope & onboarding manifest
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@neuroflux.ai>, Tom Brookes <tbrookes@neuroflux.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: NeuroFlux discovery — pilot scope & onboarding manifest

Hi Samira / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed lightweight onboarding manifesto so we can confirm alignment and get a pilot kicked off next week. I kept this intentionally concise — please flag anything missing.

Key pain & goals you reiterated
- High cost per inference on current hosted solution (esp. batch scoring).
- Unpredictable tail latency during peak batch windows; hurting UX for the customer-facing search product.
- Need reproducible evals to ensure any cost-saving optimizations don’t regress accuracy.

Proposed pilot objective (6-week sprint)
- Demonstrate 3x reduction in token cost at comparable quality on your paraphrase-ranking model.
- Latency SLO: 95th < 150ms for 1k requests/min sustained burst.
- Deliverables: eval report (precision/recall/latency), prompt set (1.5k examples), and an ops runbook for staging->prod migration.

Scope & owners
- Model: customer-paraphrase-ranker-v2 (you provide baseline weights).
- Redwoods: Jonas (eng lead, runtime tuning + batching), Karthik (onboarding + data access), Mina (security & compliance).
- NeuroFlux: Jeff Li (data/infra owner), Priya Shah (product / success).

Immediate asks to enable pilot
1) Read-only access to a 20k-row sample S3 bucket (anonymized) + sample inference API keys.
2) Baseline metric snapshot (current per-token cost, 95p latency, and daily throughput).
3) Signed NDA/MAA — we attached a mutual action plan draft and a mapping spreadsheet.

Attachments (stubs):
- neuroflux-mapping-v1.xlsx (data mapping + sample row defs)
- redwood-mutual-action-plan.docx (MVP milestones + roles)

Tentative timeline
- Week 0: access + brief tech onboarding (this week)
- Weeks 1–3: runtime tuning, batching, KV prefix caching experiments
- Weeks 4–5: prompt/eval runs and quality validation
- Week 6: final report & handoff playbook

Next steps
- Can we confirm access to a sample bucket and Jeff/Priya as owners by EOD Monday?
- If yes, I’ll schedule a 30-minute kickoff (internal eng + infra + security) for Tuesday.

Thanks — Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@neuroflux.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Brookes <tbrookes@neuroflux.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NeuroFlux discovery — pilot scope & onboarding manifest

Jonas — thanks for the clear write-up. This captures things well and the timeline looks reasonable. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- Cost target: 3x reduction is aggressive but acceptable as a target; we’ll accept a slightly longer runway if needed for stability.
- Latency: 150ms 95p is our customer-facing target; internally we can tolerate 250ms for background batches.
- Data: we can provide an anonymized 25k sample S3 prefix by Monday. Jeff will provision and share a temporary cross-account role.

Owners confirmed
- Jeff Li (jeff.li@neuroflux.ai) — will handle S3 & infra creds.
- Priya Shah (priya.shah@neuroflux.ai) — PM & evaluation owner.

Security & compliance
- We expect an initial security questionnaire before any data movement; I’ve attached the sections we typically need filled out (we’ll send the canonical PDF after this thread).

Action items on our side
1) Jeff to share cross-account role + test objects by Mon 6/14.
2) Priya to share the baseline metric snapshot and a short priority list of edge cases.
3) I’ll book the 30m kickoff slot Tue (please confirm availability).

Thanks — Samira

--
Samira Khan
Head of ML Platforms, NeuroFlux
samira.k@neuroflux.ai | +1 (650) 555-3366
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@neuroflux.ai>, Jeff Li <jeff.li@neuroflux.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@neuroflux.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NeuroFlux discovery — pilot scope & onboarding manifest

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Samira. 

A few logistics from our side before kickoff:
- Mina (cc'd) will own the initial security questionnaire and can provide SOC2 artifact pointers — she’ll follow up with a checklist and a short set of evidence we need (SOC2 Type II summary, encryption-at-rest details, access-control snapshot).
- Karthik will run the onboarding meeting and cover the tokenization/sequence-length expectations so we size batching correctly.

Scheduling: Tue works. I’m proposing Tue 6/15 11:00am PT for a 30-minute kickoff (internal eng + NeuroFlux infra + PM). If that doesn’t work, propose two windows.

One more ask: please include a short prioritized list of 10–20 example prompts or query types that represent your high-risk failure modes — this helps us craft the initial eval suite.

Thanks — Jonas

Subject: Re: NeuroFlux discovery — pilot scope & onboarding manifest — security & access steps

Hi Samira / Jeff — nice to meet you over email. I’m Mina (security/compliance at Redwood) — quick operational checklist to keep the pilot moving without surprises: 

Access steps (recommended sequence)
1) Jeff creates a cross-account IAM role for a read-only S3 prefix and emails the role ARN to redwood-security@redwood.ai. Include a short expiry (30d) and a minimal policy scope.
2) NeuroFlux shares a small API key with scope limited to the sample inference endpoint (test/staging only). We’ll accept short-lived keys or a signed URL option.
3) NeuroFlux provides a sanitized baseline metrics export (CSV) and a small CSV of labeled examples for the eval set (we requested 1.5k earlier).

Security docs we need (short list)
- SOC2 Type II summary or attestation (we only need the summary page initially).
- Encryption at rest/encryption in transit details for the sample data.
- Contact for audit / compliance (in case deeper review needed).

Once we have the cross-account role and sample data, we will:
- Provision a staging environment scoped to your sample data.
- Run a short validation pass (<48h) to confirm tokenization parity and compute sizing.

I’ll also create a ticket in our onboarding tracker and share the link in a follow-up so both teams can attach artifacts.

Small note on configuration: if you expect long context (>2k tokens) on a subset of queries, call that out now — it affects caching & batching strategy.

Happy to hop on the kickoff; Tue 6/15 11:00am PT works for the security slot as well.

Best — Mina

--
